player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} Checkers shawng hte hku nna, {color} re.
Nanhte sa ai gaw, chess-style notation hte [fileRank fileRank] shawng hku nna, ga shagu '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7) ngu ai.
Hpung shingjawng:
  • Shingra hte sha re ai gaw, tawn kaw nna 1 sha shawng hku nna.
  • Daphte hte sha re ai gaw, karum sha hte hkrat kaw nna.
  • Sha re ai gaw, mungdan kaw nna shawng hku nna, hpung shingjawng re.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hta move format sha yang gaw na ai. [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3], htawng.
invalid_move.illegal: Htawng hku hkan [{move}] gaw hkrai rai.

game_action.moved: Player {player_id} gaw {move} hku hkan galaw rai.

outcome.red_no_pieces: Hkyeng gaw, pala n lu mat sai. Nlung ni dang ai!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Masha mi a lam hte sha rai, Mungga grai hkra!
outcome.no_moves: Player {player_id} gaw gara shara hta mung n lu mat sai.
outcome.draw: Hpang jahtum na matu, dai hpe galaw u.
